tasks.title: Console stack documentation resolves to pulse-deploy full with correct host and container ports
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, steps 1-3 and completion evidence; Required behavior rules 1-5 and console per-passage bullets; Documentation inventory; Common acceptance A1-A9; Counterexamples, non-goals, security and performance constraints. One documentation-only task implements the entire small section.

acceptance.command: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && export BASE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" && git rev-parse "$BASE" && bun install --frozen-lockfile
acceptance.expected: Before any documentation edit: exit 0 on a clean implementation base; record BASE SHA and preserve it for all later commands. Use repository Bun 1.4.0 and the frozen lockfile; dependencies/hooks may install but no tracked file may change.

acceptance.command: for run in 1 2 3; do bun run check; result=$?; printf 'BASE run %s exit %s\n' "$run" "$result"; done
acceptance.expected: A7: run on BASE before editing and record each of the three exit codes, full output and test pass counts. A passing baseline means all three exit 0 with the same recorded pass count and the unchanged repository 80% line-coverage threshold, with no exact coverage percentage expectation. The spec claims no passing baseline or numerical pass count. Report baseline failures explicitly as unrelated, with output; do not call flaky controls passing or alter tests/tool config. No focused Bun run is required.

acceptance.expected: A4: counts are literally 1 and 1; host-port environment grep exits 1. Inspect api and both extended services: no api ports in full or common api; status/console environment uses http://api:3000. If these independent facts moved, stop with needs-input as required by the plan. Review all three corrected passages: README preserves everything before its last sentence, including image bind 0.0.0.0:8082, and names deploy full/full/compose.yaml with host loopback 127.0.0.1:${PULSE_CONSOLE_PORT:-8082} to container 8082. docs/configuration.md names and links full, explains host-port interpolation without forwarding PULSE_CONSOLE_PORT into the container, image default 8082, internal PULSE_API_URL: http://api:3000 and no published api host port. docs/index.md retains the API configuration link for the service and splits stack variables into a new bullet linking full/README.md#variables and full/compose.yaml. Every start command, if added, names the deploy checkout, scripts/init-secrets.sh once and docker compose -f full/compose.yaml up -d. Reject every applicable Counterexample, including wrong setup/anchor, status described as loopback, published api 3000, console loopback inside its container, and the overbroad dotenv claim. With host overrides 18080/18082 only host ports change; container targets stay 8080/8082. No Docker startup, browser check or Compose end-to-end test is required for Markdown corrections.

acceptance.command:
python3 -c 'import os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
source = os.getcwd()
base = os.environ["BASE"]
allowed = ["README.md","docs/configuration.md","docs/index.md"]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pulse-854-scope-") as temp:
    repo = pathlib.Path(temp) / "fixture"
    subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--no-hardlinks", source, str(repo)], check=True)
    def git(*args):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)
    def must(*args):
        result = git(*args)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
        return result.stdout
    must("checkout", "--detach", base)
    must("config", "user.name", "scope fixture")
    must("config", "user.email", "scope-fixture@example.invalid")
    must("config", "core.hooksPath", "/dev/null")
    protected = [p for p in must("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", base).splitlines() if p not in allowed]
    assert "AGENTS.md" in protected
    def checks():
        paths = sorted(must("diff", "--name-only", base, "HEAD").splitlines())
        return [int(paths != sorted(allowed)), int(bool(must("diff", "--name-only", "--cached"))), int(bool(must("diff", "--name-only"))), int(bool(must("status", "--porcelain"))), git("diff", "--exit-code", base, "HEAD", "--", *protected).returncode]
    def verify(label, expected):
        actual = checks()
        print(label, "commits/index/worktree/status/protected:", actual)
        assert actual == expected, (label, actual, expected)
    for name in allowed:
        path = repo / name
        path.write_text(path.read_text() + "\nfixture allowed edit\n")
    must("add", "--", *allowed)
    must("commit", "-m", "docs: fixture allowed paths")
    clean = must("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
    verify("allowed docs-only commit", [0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    def reset():
        must("reset", "--hard", clean)
        must("clean", "-fd")
    def change():
        path = repo / "AGENTS.md"
        path.write_text(path.read_text() + "\nfixture protected edit\n")
    change()
    must("add", "AGENTS.md")
    must("commit", "-m", "test: fixture protected commit")
    verify("committed protected change", [1, 0, 0, 0, 1])
    reset()
    change()
    must("add", "AGENTS.md")
    verify("staged protected change", [0, 1, 0, 1, 0])
    reset()
    change()
    verify("unstaged protected change", [0, 0, 1, 1, 0])
    reset()
    (repo / "scope-fixture-untracked").write_text("fixture\n")
    verify("untracked file", [0, 0, 0, 1, 0])
    reset()
    change()
    must("add", "AGENTS.md")
    must("restore", "--worktree", "--source=" + base, "--", "AGENTS.md")
    assert git("diff", "--quiet", base, "--", "AGENTS.md").returncode == 0
    verify("staged change with restored worktree", [0, 1, 1, 1, 0])
    reset()
    change()
    must("add", "AGENTS.md")
    must("commit", "-m", "test: fixture hidden committed change")
    must("restore", "--worktree", "--source=" + base, "--", "AGENTS.md")
    assert git("diff", "--quiet", base, "--", "AGENTS.md").returncode == 0
    verify("committed change with restored worktree", [1, 0, 1, 1, 1])
print("scope fixture: all seven cases pass; disposable clone removed")'
acceptance.expected: A6: exit 0; all seven fixture cases print the expected exit vectors for independent commit/index/worktree/status/protected checks. Allowed docs-only commit passes; extra protected committed, staged and unstaged changes and an untracked path are detected. Both restored-worktree cases prove that a zero aggregate diff against BASE cannot hide the index or HEAD change. Fixture mutation is confined to its disposable clone, hooks disabled only there; clone is removed before final A5. Never bypass implementation-checkout hooks or commit a helper.

Record exit status and test pass count, without an exact coverage-percentage expectation. Compare any failures with the three recorded BASE runs and report unrelated failures explicitly; never change tests, locks or tool config to pass. No focused tests or new test files. No Docker bench (#834); no performance impact expected. Any test-CPU delta is informational and requires interleaved base/branch runs.

acceptance.command:
python3 -c 'import os, subprocess
base = os.environ["BASE"]
allowed = ["README.md","docs/configuration.md","docs/index.md"]
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], text=True).splitlines()
assert sorted(git("diff", "--name-only", base, "HEAD")) == sorted(allowed), "committed paths differ from exact allowed list"
assert not git("diff", "--name-only", "--cached"), "index is dirty"
assert not git("diff", "--name-only"), "working tree is dirty"
assert not git("status", "--porcelain"), "status is dirty"
protected = [p for p in git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", base) if p not in allowed]
assert protected
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--exit-code", base, "HEAD", "--", *protected], check=True)
print("scope: committed paths, index, working tree, status and protected paths pass")'
acceptance.expected: A5 after the last implementation commit and fixture cleanup: exit 0. git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD equals exactly README.md docs/configuration.md docs/index.md; git diff --name-only --cached and git diff --name-only are separately empty; git status --porcelain is empty. git diff --exit-code "$BASE" HEAD -- <protected files> exits 0 for the full complement from git ls-tree, including unchanged docs, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Dockerfile, sources, assets, tests, scripts, config, locks and CI. No protected paths silently omitted and no new extra file. Re-run after any final commit or change.
